How it works

1

Sign in with WhatsApp

Your mobile number and a one-time code. The booking sits on that number, so you can cancel it later.

2

Choose date, time, adults and children

We seat the party together. Groups larger than 20 should call 070227 71888.

3

Arrive at your time

Show your code at the counter and we take you to the table.

Tables are held for 10 minutes only. The hold starts at your booked arrival time, and the table is released automatically after that — no call needed, it just goes back to the floor. Please be at Zeva at your booked time. Running late? Call 070227 71888 before the 10 minutes are up and we will do our best.

Good to know
